# Vendored scripts

The reader serves these from its own binary, so pages make no third-party
requests. Both are MIT licensed (licence files beside them). Update by
fetching the same paths at a new pinned version from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<package>@<version>/dist/`.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `mermaid.min.js` | mermaid | 11.4.1 |
| `katex/katex.min.js`, `katex/katex.min.css`, `katex/fonts/*.woff2` | katex | 0.16.11 |
